read_cluster_object_info: read cluster object info from an Aria scene input folder and cluster folder with a specified cluster ID
filter_cluster_by_iou: filter cluster matching results by minimum IoU threshold to find relevant views for a specific cluster
load_aria_scene_info: load Aria scene information with RGB camera data and stride 1 for the original training sequence
extract_camera_masks: extract and resize detection masks from pickled gzip files for each matching view in the cluster
create_cluster_scene_info: create a SceneInfo object with cluster cameras, point cloud, and nerf normalization for 3D reconstruction
